connections.how: pass through the doorway with the wall-mounted mirror on your left and turn right past the white pillar onto the rug
walk to the end of the rug near the low storage alcove with shelves and turn left through the doorway past the wall-mounted mirror
walk straight along the rug with the bottle-shaped J&B sign on your left toward the window ahead
at the end of the red patterned runner rug by the window, look to your right to see the wooden bunk beds above the stairs
turn around from the bunk beds and wooden staircase, walk back onto the red patterned runner rug, and turn right through the doorway before the bottle-shaped J&B sign
Having the white toilet on your right and white sink on your left, turn around to exit the doorway, turn left, and go past the small curtained window and wooden bunk beds to the top of the stairs
walk down the wooden staircase to the terracotta tile floor where the dining table with bench is ahead on the left
walk past the dining table with bench and small white appliance to the base of the wooden staircase and climb up
at the bottom of the stairs, turn right between the floral armchairs and the doorway to the blue toilet, and go straight through the doorway ahead
walk forward with the pink floral bedspread on your right toward the small table with lace cloth and lamp in the corner, arriving at the window above the white radiator
turn right with the window above the white radiator on your left and walk toward the tall light-wood wardrobe
turn right in front of the wardrobe to face the dark wooden nightstand with lamp next to the pink floral bedspread
walk past the pink floral bedspread on your left through the open doorway and continue straight to the base of the wooden staircase with the dining table with bench on your right
at the top of the stairs, turn right onto the red patterned runner rug, walk past the bottle-shaped J&B sign on your right, and continue straight to the low storage alcove with shelves at the end
turn right from the low storage alcove and walk through the upper open wooden door onto the red patterned rug by the bed
walk straight across the red patterned rug by the bed with the bed under the sloped wooden ceiling on your right to reach the window above the white radiator
turn around with the bed under the sloped wooden ceiling on your right and walk back to the open wooden door

walk out through the doorway past the wall-mounted mirror on your left and white pillar on your right, turn right onto the red patterned runner rug, and turn right at the small curtained window to go down the stairs
walk forward from the bottom of the wooden staircase with the dining table with bench on your left to pass between the floral armchairs
walk between the floral armchairs toward the glass double doors, then turn right past the blue sofa on your left to reach the corner fireplace and light-wood hutch
turn around with the corner fireplace and light-wood hutch on your left, and walk straight between the floral armchairs back to the dining table with bench
with the dining table with bench on your right and the small white appliance and wooden staircase on your left, walk straight ahead to the open wooden door
walk through the open wooden door with the wooden chest of drawers on your right to reach the single bed with blue cover ahead
turn around with the single bed with blue cover on your left and the wooden chest of drawers on your right, and walk out through the doorway

walk out of the doorway past the dining table with bench on your right, then turn left between the black dishwasher and stove on your left and the wood-paneled counter on your right toward the glass-paned exterior door

turn around from the glass-paned exterior door and look between the wood-paneled counter on your left and the black dishwasher and stove on your right toward the wooden staircase ahead in the distance

walk_summary: Start by passing through the upper open wooden door and past the wall-mounted mirror onto the red patterned runner rug.
Walk along the red patterned runner rug past the bottle-shaped J&B sign on the left toward the small curtained window.
At the top of the wooden staircase, look right at the wooden bunk beds, then turn around onto the red patterned runner rug.
Step right through the doorway to view the metal shower stall, white toilet, and white sink, then exit and turn left.
Pass the small curtained window and wooden bunk beds on the left and walk down the wooden staircase.
At the bottom of the stairs near the dining table with bench, turn right between the floral armchairs and the doorway with the blue toilet.
Walk through the doorway ahead to the pink floral bedspread.
Walk around the pink floral bedspread past the small table with lace cloth and lamp and the window above the white radiator.
Turn right past the tall light-wood wardrobe and dark wooden nightstand with lamp, then exit through the doorway back to the base of the wooden staircase.
Climb up the wooden staircase, turn right onto the red patterned runner rug past the bottle-shaped J&B sign, and walk to the low storage alcove with shelves.
From the low storage alcove with shelves, turn right through the upper open wooden door onto the red patterned rug by the bed.
Walk past the bed under the sloped wooden ceiling on the right to the window under the sloped ceiling.
Turn around, exit through the upper open wooden door past the wall-mounted mirror and white pillar, and walk along the red patterned runner rug to the wooden staircase.
Walk down the wooden staircase, pass the dining table with bench on the left, and go between the floral armchairs toward the glass double doors.
Turn right past the blue sofa to face the corner fireplace and light-wood hutch.
Turn around, walk back between the floral armchairs to the dining table with bench, and look toward the blue toilet, pink floral bedspread, and small white appliance.
Walk past the small white appliance and the base of the wooden staircase on the left toward the lower open wooden door.
Briefly look back at the wooden staircase, small white appliance, and floral armchairs, then walk through the lower open wooden door.
Inside, pass the wooden chest of drawers on the right to reach the single bed with blue cover.
Turn around and exit through the lower open wooden door toward the dining table with bench.
Walk forward and turn left between the black dishwasher and stove on the left and the wood-paneled counter on the right to reach the glass-paned exterior door.
Turn around between the wood-paneled counter and the black dishwasher and stove to face the wooden staircase in the distance.
